description: LibraryService (plan §11.1, §15.4, §15.8, §22), on the engine executor with ProblemService and the Scheduler, over a file system and database in memory; the clock starts at 2026-10-02T20:00:00.000Z. Libraries are the configuration's (id, name, path). A library is online when its folder exists and holds .bromelia-library (LibraryMarker.decode) whose id is the stored one; with no stored row the marker is adopted (row: the marker's id, attachedAt its created). Offline reasons, raised as a problem scoped to the library (id <code>:library:<id>): library.offline{library: name, path} (warning, action openSettings) when the folder is missing, the marker can't be read or decoded, a stored library lost its marker, or a check hasn't come back by the next 30 s tick; library.notAttached{path} (warning, action attachLibrary) when the folder exists, has no marker and was never stored; library.markerMismatch{path, found, expected} (error, openSettings) for another library's marker. Every check stores online and, when online, lastSeenAt (LibraryRepository.setSeen). A change of online or reason publishes libraryChanged{library: LibraryDto} (freeBytes from FileSystem.volume when online and it answers; lastSeenAt when known), then raises or clears the problems; the scheduler blocks LibraryWrite(id) with the reason while offline. start(): reads the stored rows (when each library was last seen), checks every library and completes when that round is applied; then every 30 s. A round's results are applied together, in configuration order, when all have come back, or by the next tick (those not back are offline and aren't checked again until they come back; a late result is applied alone). check(): a round now. configChanged: libraries added are checked, removed ones dropped (problems cleared, scheduler unblocked). attach(id, path, name): library.pathMissing{path} unless path is a folder (never created); library.alreadyAttached{path, library: the marker's name} when it has a marker; else writes LibraryMarker.make(id, path, name or the folder's name, now) (mode 0644), stores the row and the library is online. require(id): library.notFound (not configured), else the offline reason, else {id, path}. stagingDirectory(id, job): <path>/.bromelia/staging/<job>, each folder made with parentsMustExist. commit(unit, intent, files) (plan §22.3 steps 4–6, from a worker): library.notFound unless the destination is under the library; the library's reason unless online; the marker is read again; commit.inProgress{unit} while another commit of the unit runs; an open intent for the unit is rolled forward instead; fs.notFound for a missing staging folder, staging SHA256SUMS or item; library.folderExists{path} for an existing destination unless merge; fs.alreadyExists{path} for a file item whose destination exists; then UnitRepository.beginCommit (state committing), crash point commit.afterIntent, the move: a destination that doesn't exist (not merge) gets the staging folder renamed whole (its parents made under the root first), otherwise each item in seq order (a file renamed, a folder moveMerging'd); markMoved after each, then crash point commit.afterMove:<n> (n counting items marked); then SHA256SUMS: merged into the destination's (Sha256Sums.merge, written atomically, 0644) and the staging copy removed when it is still in staging; empty staging folders removed; every folder from the library root down to each committed file and the staging folder's parent synced (any failure fails the commit, the intent stays); crash point commit.beforeDone; finishCommit with the unit committed (quarantined for quarantine) at now and the files given. quarantine(unit, intent, files, tag): the destination is <library>/_Quarantine/<ConflictNamer.next('<last part of the intent's destination> [<tag>]')>, not merged. rollForward(intent): the marker check, then the same move: an item whose source is gone and whose destination exists counts as moved when its SHA-256 (read back through openForReading) is the item's (or it has none, or is a folder); a destination that differs is fs.alreadyExists{path}; neither is fs.notFound{path: source}; the files are the destination SHA256SUMS lines of the unit's items (size from stat, role title). Given: config (libraries), libraries (stored rows), files {path: text} and dirs (folders; parents implied), fail [{op, path, error, times}] (the fake file system's call fails so, every time or that many times), hold [{op, path}] (the call waits for release), crashAt (the crash point stops the operation, as a killed engine would). Ops: start (wait: false: its result comes when it finishes), check, libraries, {require: id}, {staging: {library, job}}, {blocked: id} (the scheduler's reason code for a LibraryWrite of it, or null when granted), {attach: {id, path, name}}, {configure: libraries} (a new configuration, configChanged published), {advance: s}, {fs: {put: {path: text}} | {moveAway: path}} (changes from outside), {held: op} (waits until that many calls are held), release, {commit|quarantine: {unit: {id, path, name}, intent: {staging, destination, merge, items: [[from, to, sha256, isDir]]}, files: [[path, size, sha256, role]], tag, wait}}, restart (a new service, bus, scheduler and problems on the same files and database), rollForward (every open intent, oldest first: a list of results), {dump: intents} ([[unit, ['seq from to[ dir][ moved]']]]). Expect: results (ok, a value, {error}, {crashed: point}); events (libraryChanged, problemRaised, problemCleared and configChanged, in order, across restarts; seq as published, so the scheduler events of a blocked op leave gaps); problems; files (every file afterwards) and modes; dirs (every folder); synced (folders synced, sorted, unique); db {libraries, units [{id, path, state, committedAt}], intents (as dump), unitFiles {unit: [[path, size, sha256, role]]}}.
